display_long_description:
# Come Fly With Us!

Pilot Alex the Squirrel’s plane as enemies swarm right into your space. Dodge, shoot, and strategize. Fast, fun, and full of chaos - **Welcome to Alex and the Jets.**


# Fly in your surroundings!
✈️  Experience your space like never before! Transform your physical environment into a high-speed aerial playground. With intuitive controls, vibrant visuals, and a charming cast of characters, this MR adventure redefines how you move, play, and explore.

[media]

# Turn your surroundings into a thrilling dogfight arena
🔫 Fight AWESOME and challenging enemies. Face off against waves of dynamic enemies, dodge incoming fire, and pull off daring maneuvers.

[media]

# Use the doughnuts to gain power-ups
🍩 From poison, through shield to missile: doughnuts will gear you up to make sure you've got what it takes to survive.

[media]

# Enjoy side-quests!
🎃 Perfect for showing off your flying finesse. Play with bouncing pumpkins, hovering cheese, and a bunch of other quirky surprises. 

[media]

# VR-Mode
🥽 Fully immerse yourself! Other than Quest 2 support, you can experience the same experience in a VR-decorated room, enhanced with interactable objects for extra fun.

[media]

Join our community on Discord: www.discord.gg/Alex-Jets
